static_traits.name: Wen Hao
static_traits.family_status: No children;growing distant from friends and family after the Divorce
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk to,but has not yet shared negative thoughts with them;Social support is rather thin
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;no similar psychological issues before the Divorce;never received psychotherapy in the past
static_traits.language_features: Highly cooperative,expresses clearly,with good logic and steady speech rate,able to self-Reflect and accept Guidance

basic_info.main_problem: After separating from my wife,I realized all my relationships are doomed to fail.This thought keeps troubling me,bringing hopelessness and feelings of isolation.
basic_info.core_demands: I want to deal with these thinking patterns and find ways to improve my view of relationships.
growth_experiences: The marriage ended in Divorce six months ago,with an emotionally turbulent and highly stressful Divorce process;since then,thoughts of 'relationships doomed to fail' appear almost daily,especially worsening when meeting new friends or considering starting a new relationship;Work attention affected,Sleep disturbance,Reduced interest in past pleasures,and gradually drifting from friends and family.

Several relationships before the Divorce also ultimately could not be maintained;these experiences are subjectively viewed as a 'pattern of failure',further Reinforcement pessimistic expectations about future relationships.

core_beliefs: Intimate relationships are doomed to fail
I cannot maintain a stable relationship

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a new relationship is started or approached, it will eventually fail and cause hurt again
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Retreating in advance or keeping distance, lowering expectations; using work and hobbies to distract attention so as to avoid engagement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This relationship will not work out,I will get hurt again.

special_situations.event: Considering whether to start a new intimate relationship
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a relationship cannot last long,it equals complete failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Judging relationships by the standard of 'either success or failure',choosing not to start to avoid 'failure'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It will fail in the end anyway,starting has no meaning.

special_situations.event: Recalling the Divorce and past relationships that could not be maintained
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If past relationships all ended,future relationships will be the same
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Treats the conclusion of 'destined to fail' as a criterion to reduce the gap between hope and disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These experiences have proven I am not suited for any relationship.

special_situations.event: Negative experiences or uncertain details arising in interactions with others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any slight negative or uncertain clue is a sign of future failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overanalyzing details, repeatedly playing movies in the mind, and reducing further contact in order to 'protect oneself'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Here we go again, something will go wrong; sooner or later it will end with a bad result.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to build and maintain safe, reliable intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being hurt again,Being rejected and failure,thus becoming more isolated and helpless
defense_goal: Avoiding hurt through distancing and preemptively negating relationships
Controlling uncertainty and relieving Anxiety through Intellectualization and over-analysis

object_relations.self_representation: A person who has failed and is isolated, someone who finds it hard to maintain relationships
object_relations.object_representation: Others / partners who may hurt or eventually leave

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites deep recall of the concrete emotional experiences and attachment needs in the divorce
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Talking deeply about emotions will make me more vulnerable, and I may be seen as weak or hurt again
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describing the course of events in objective, conceptualized language, avoiding feeling words and details; tone steady and rather calm, emphasizing 'facts' and conclusions rather than emotions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the topic involves whether to contact friends or try new relationships
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Getting close to others means greater risk and pain; keeping distance is more 'reasonable'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes justifying reasons such as being busy with work or needing to 'get into the right state first', with a calm but firm tone, to avoid actual contact and attempts.

manifestations: Feeling increasingly isolated after divorce, keeping distance from friends and family
Believes relationships are doomed to fail; hard to get close to others
Being enveloped by hopelessness when meeting new friends
outcomes: Social avoidance and Reduced social support

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths.
manifestations: use absolute expressions such as 'doomed to fail''will all fail'
Internalizing several bad experiences as universal law,difficulty accessing exceptions and positive experiences

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Overanalyzes details and possible outcomes before a new relationship, repeatedly rehearsing the worst case
Delays or avoids actual contact and attempts due to excessive caution

positive_force: Actively seeks help and is willing to change, with a positive attitude
Having some self-awareness,able to identify and describe one's own thinking patterns
Stable work and still a few friends to talk to
Having had Good periods in past relationships,which can serve as counter-evidence and resources
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, jumping to conclusions, and black-and-white thinking are significant
Social avoidance and drifting from family and friends,Weak social support
Sleep disturbance and Decreased interest worsening the negative thinking cycle
Over-analyzing to seek certainty,instead amplifying Anxiety and Anticipation of failure
Traumatic emotions from the Divorce event not yet processed

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing about intimate relationships and repetitive negative automatic thoughts ('the relationship is doomed to fail')
antecedent: Considering whether to start a new relationship
Negative interactions with others or uncertain clues arising
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional trauma from the Divorce and negative Reinforcement,generalizing past failures broadly to the future and solidifying them into beliefs
target_behavior.function: Emotional avoidance and Self-protection,trying to reduce the sense of risk of rejection and hurt
target_behavior.consequence: Hopelessness and Increased sense of isolation,worsening sleep and Reduced interest,Work performance affected

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and drifting from family and friends
antecedent: Before social invitations or preparing to contact others, the thought 'doomed to fail' appears
Worries when thinking about possible intimacy or attachment needs
target_behavior.core_reason: Anticipation of hurt and failure,Anxiety about uncertainty
target_behavior.function: Escapes situations that may bring pain and being judged, maintaining superficial security
target_behavior.consequence: Further reduced Social support,worsening loneliness,negative beliefs further Reinforcement
